edit_ops.detail: pow(pow(x, contrast), 1/gamma) is applied to two different quantities here (contrast before ACES, gamma after), so they cannot merge; but the ACES fit itself is a rational function whose numerator and denominator share x: evaluate it with one division and two fma per channel, and drop the dead mix(vec3(lum), c, 1.0).
